ProptechOS is that system.

AI agents built on that foundation perform autonomous operational work: adjusting energy setpoints, triggering maintenance workflows, compiling ESG reporting data, and managing tenant services — continuously, without manual intervention. ProptechOS is where recommendations become actions — autonomously, across the full portfolio.

For property owners and real estate operators, this means:
— Energy management that acts on what the data says. Vasakronan reduced energy consumption by 36% using the ProptechOS Optimize application. 
— Sustainability and ESG compliance automated through real-time data pipelines, replacing manual reporting processes. 
— Facility operations improved through predictive maintenance and autonomous service management. 
— A growing ecosystem of certified best-of-breed applications — from energy analytics to building certification — deployable without creating new data silos.

The platform runs on Microsoft Azure, is available in the Azure Marketplace, and integrates with 100+ building systems through pre-built connectors. Customers include HH, Vasakronan, Hufvudstaden, Folksam, KLP, AFA Fastigheter, and Familjebostäder.

For property companies ready to move from fragmented proptech investments to a coherent, AI-driven operating model — ProptechOS is the infrastructure that makes it possible.
